hooks.command: tok_file="$HOME/.agentic/token"; repo=".agentic.json"; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -f "$tok_file" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$repo" ] || exit 0; tok=$(cat "$tok_file" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$tok" ] && exit 0; cfg="$HOME/.agentic/client-config.json"; [ -f "$cfg" ] || exit 0; proj_url="${AGENTIC_PROJECTS_URL:-$(jq -r '.projects_url // empty' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -z "$proj_url" ] && exit 0; base="${proj_url%%/api/v1/*}"; project_id=$(jq -r '.project_id // empty' "$repo" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$project_id" ] && exit 0; input=$(cat); tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; proj_root="$(pwd)"; fp="${fp#${proj_root}/}"; ext="${fp##*.}"; case "$ext" in py|java|kt|kts|go|ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|cs|cpp|c|cc|h|hpp|rs|scala|swift|dart|rb|php|ex|exs|clj|sql|graphql|proto|tf) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; lc=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '((.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // "") | split("\n") | length)' 2>/dev/null); now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" 2>/dev/null || echo "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"); line_start=1; fl=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '(.tool_input.new_string // "" | split("\n") | .[0])' 2>/dev/null); [ "$tool" = "Edit" ] && [ -f "$fp" ] && [ -n "$fl" ] && gln=$(grep -nF "$fl" "$fp" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d: -f1) && [ -n "$gln" ] && line_start=$gln; line_end=$((line_start + ${lc:-1} - 1)); payload=$(jq -nc --arg pid "$project_id" --arg fp "$fp" --argjson ls "${line_start}" --argjson le "${line_end}" --arg now "$now" '{"project_id":$pid,"commit_sha":"WORKSPACE_PENDING","attributions":[{"file_path":$fp,"line_start":$ls,"line_end":$le,"generator":"claude_code","generated_at":$now}]}'); curl -sf -X POST "$base/api/v1/ai-attributions/bulk" -H "Authorization: Bearer $tok" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$payload" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
